title: Representation Affects Retrieval: A Case Study of Skill Discovery and Routing in a Multimodal Agent Harness
abstract: arXiv:2608.20389v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A production agent harness must discover and rank, from a growing library of skills, the one most appropriate for a user's task. At small scale this selection happens in context: the LLM planner chooses among skill representations exposed in its system prompt, without an explicit embedding-based retrieval step. We treat this in-context selection as the small-N counterpart to embedding-based skill retrieval at scale, and present a case study of how Tinycloud, a production multimodal video agent harness, represents its skills for the planner. The harness ships skills under two recurring representations: tool-skills that wrap a single external API or system tool and serve as primitive vocabulary, and workflow-skills that orchestrate tool-skill calls plus a template render to produce one named deliverable. translated_title: 表示影响检索：多模态智能体框架中技能发现与路由的案例研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20389v1 公告类型：新 摘要：一个生产级智能体框架必须从不断增长的技能库中发现并排序最适合用户任务的技能。在小规模情况下，这种选择发生在上下文中：LLM规划器在其系统提示中暴露的技能表示中进行选择，无需显式的基于嵌入的检索步骤。我们将这种上下文内选择视为大规模基于嵌入的技能检索的小规模对应物，并呈现一个案例研究，展示生产级多模态视频智能体框架Tinycloud如何表示其技能以供规划器使用。该框架以两种反复出现的表示方式发布技能：工具技能，包装单个外部API或系统工具并作为原始词汇；工作流技能，编排工具技能调用加上模板渲染以生成一个命名的交付物。框架通过系统提示中的两个表面暴露它们：内联主体表面（完整指令、脚本、模板）用于自动加载...
tldr: 本文通过Tinycloud框架的案例研究，揭示了技能表示方式（工具技能与工作流技能）如何影响智能体在上下文中的选择与路由，强调了表示设计对检索效率的关键作用。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a case study of the Tinycloud framework, revealing how skill representations (tool-skills vs. workflow-skills) influence in-context selection and routing in a multimodal agent, highlighting the critical role of representation design in retrieval efficiency.
